0.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4TOWN_00584_GRAMSOL_000_001
0.description: Move along, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>. Nothin' to see here.

1.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4TOWN_00584_GRAMSOL_001_001
1.description: Sorry, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>, but I've nothin' to sell till the next shipment comes.

2.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4TOWN_00584_SYSTEM_001_002
2.description: You must progress further through the Shadowbringers main scenario in order to access this vendor's wares.

3.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4TOWN_00584_SYSTEM_001_012
3.description: Once you have made a substantial contribution to the safety of Lakeland, Kholusia, Amh Araeng, Il Mheg, the Rak'tika Greatwood, and the Tempest, you will be able to trade with this vendor.

4.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4TOWN_00584_GRAMSOL_002_001
4.description: You're in luck, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>. Shipments of goods from all over are finally makin' their way to the Crystarium. If you're willin' to part with a few bicolor gemstones, mayhap we can strike a bargain.

5.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4TOWN_00584_SYSTEM_999_001
5.description: You may now trade with Gramsol!

6.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4TOWN_00584_SYSTEM_002_002
6.description: Collect bicolor gemstones to trade for a variety of goods.

7.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4TOWN_00584_GRAMSOL_003_001
7.description: Anything you fancy, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>? If you've bicolor gemstones to spend, I'm sure I have something you're after.

8.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4TOWN_00584_PEDRONILLE_000_001
8.description: I am terribly sorry, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>, but I have nothing to sell at present.

9.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4TOWN_00584_PEDRONILLE_001_001
9.description: I am terribly sorry, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. A new shipment of wares is due any day now.

10.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4TOWN_00584_PEDRONILLE_002_001
10.description: I have the most wonderful news! We've just received a shipment of goods to sell. Perhaps we have something to your liking?

11.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4TOWN_00584_SYSTEM_999_002
11.description: You may now trade with Pedronille!
